Name: Kent Does The Dishes
Author: sqbr
Description:
This is a pretty small mod, and doesn't attempt to dig very deeply into how Kent and Jodi might seriously address their many issues. I'm definitely not saying that doing the dishes will cure PTSD! It just offers a few small positive changes: Kent does the dishes in the morning, allowing Jodi to sleep in and giving him something to do, and a few dialogue changes implying that they're both a little less unhappy.

[b]Art Credits:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued - (Furry Overhaul Mod) Plus Genderswaps[/url] (note: not open use, but allows for compatibility patches as in this mod)

[b]Installation:
[/b]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

There may be some weirdness about Jodi's movements on the first day the mod kicks in, but this should settle after that farmer goes to sleep.

[b]Configuration:
[/b]Either edit config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. [b]
[/b]
[u]KentSprite[/u]: What style to use for Kent's dish-washing animation, as in the screenshot above.
[list]
[*]Vanilla: matches the original game sprite.
[*]Cuter: matches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites [/url]
[*]Anthro: Matches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued [/url]
[/list][u]WaitUntil[/u]: How long to wait before the changes kick in.
[list]
[*]Year 2: the moment Kent is in town.
[/list][list]
[*]Year 2 Summer: Kent has been in town at least a month
[*]﻿Year 3: Kent has been in town at least a year
[*]Eight hearts: Kent and Jodi are both at 8 hearts with the player
[*]Ten hearts: Kent and Jodi are both at 10 hearts with the player
[/list]
[u]EditDialogue[/u]: Whether to apply the dialogue edits. Turn off if you're playing in a language other than English. [b]
[/b][u]KentWinter[/u]: Whether to put Kent in his Winter outfit.[b]

Compatible Mods:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]
Anthro Characters Continued[/url]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4217]SFG's No More War - Kent as Journalist (Content Patcher)[/url][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13434]Gender Setter
[/url][url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]Diverse Stardew Valley
[/url]
This mod never mentions the farmer's gender, so mods just affecting that should be fine.
[b]
Semi-compatible mods:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1942?tab=description]Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul﻿[/url]: the vanilla sprite is similar but not identical
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿: Kent's outfit will switch back to the default when he's doing the dishes.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]: Nothing actively contradicts this mod, but the tone will overall be more like the darker original game canon.

[b]Incompatible mods:[/b]

This mod edits the part of Jodi's disposition setting where she sleeps, adds a "dishes" animation to Kent's sprite, edits the schedules for Kent and Jodi, and the dialogue for Kent, Jodi, and Vincent. It will thus be plausibly incompatible with any mod not listed above that affects these things. It is specifically incompatible with any mods which change Jodi, Kent, Sam, or Vincent's names, though I intend to make it compatible with Gender Setter.

I have no idea if this is compatible with SVE, and it probably does weird things in multiplayer. If you try either of these, let me know how it goes!
